summaries.zero: Rank 0 reads the input, takes part in 3 broadcasts as the root, integrates its slice, and is the root of the reduce. It prints the result.
summaries.worker: Rank {r} takes part in the same 3 broadcasts and the reduce, but only as a participant. It prints nothing.
